name: Wati
tagline: A well-funded, Shopify-backed WhatsApp AI platform with genuinely strong commerce capability — undermined by a serious, repeated pattern of billing and cancellation complaints.
tldr: Wati grew out of Clare.AI, a 2016 Hong Kong enterprise chatbot maker whose clients included JPMorgan and Fidelity, launching as a dedicated WhatsApp platform in 2020 and raising $32.3M+ total, including a Series B specifically backed by Shopify itself alongside Tiger Global and Sequoia.

Pricing runs Growth $60/mo, Pro $120/mo ('Best Value'), Business $300/mo (all annual rates, roughly 15-17% higher billed monthly), plus a ₹999 pay-as-you-go single-user option — but per-message WhatsApp fees, per-user overages, and add-ons stack on top of every tier.

The AI stack is genuinely multi-layered: KnowBot trains on files or website URLs to answer from a knowledge base, a context-aware AI Support Agent claims to automate up to 80% of routine support, and Astra AI Agents is a separate, more advanced add-on tier.

Shopify integration is a real standout, unsurprising given Shopify's own investment — a dedicated 'AI Chat & Abandoned Cart' app on the Shopify App Store recovers carts and answers order questions directly in WhatsApp.

The single most serious issue on record is billing integrity: multiple independent reviewers describe being forced into annual payments despite being told billing was monthly, continued charges after cancellation requests, and real total costs reported at roughly five times the headline price once per-message and add-on fees are included.

Best for ecommerce brands wanting deep, Shopify-specific WhatsApp AI commerce capability — but budget conservatively, get every billing term in writing before committing, and be aware that customer support responsiveness is a widely repeated independent complaint.
keyFeatures: KnowBot — trains a chatbot on uploaded files or website URLs to answer customer questions automatically from that content
A context-aware AI Support Agent that resolves routine queries without human involvement and routes complex conversations via advanced routing rules
Astra AI Agents — a more advanced AI capability tier available as an add-on on Pro and above
Wati AI Copilot — real-time agent assistance, metered by monthly credits that scale with plan tier
A dedicated 'AI Chat & Abandoned Cart' Shopify app for cart recovery and order-related conversations directly in WhatsApp

A shared Team Inbox for managing WhatsApp conversations across a team from one number
CTWA (Click-to-WhatsApp Ads) optimization and Instagram automation on Pro and above

faq.question: Is Wati a new company, or does it have a longer track record?
faq.answer: It has real history behind it: Wati grew out of Clare.AI, a Hong Kong enterprise chatbot company founded in 2016 whose clients included JPMorgan and Fidelity, before pivoting specifically to WhatsApp and launching as Wati in 2020. That's a more substantial technical pedigree than many WhatsApp-focused startups in this category.

faq.question: Why did Shopify invest in Wati?
faq.answer: Shopify participated in Wati's Series B specifically as a strategic investment, consistent with Wati's genuinely strong, purpose-built ecommerce integration — a dedicated 'AI Chat & Abandoned Cart' app on the Shopify App Store handles cart recovery and order questions directly inside WhatsApp. If your business runs on Shopify, this is one of the more credible AI-commerce integrations in this category.

faq.question: What is the most serious concern about Wati?
faq.answer: Billing integrity, and it's a specific, repeated pattern rather than an isolated complaint. Multiple independent reviewers describe being forced into annual payment despite being told billing was monthly, and separately report continued charges after submitting a cancellation request. Independent analysis has also documented cases where the real total bill — once per-message WhatsApp fees and add-ons are included — lands at roughly five times the advertised headline price. Get every billing and cancellation term confirmed in writing before signing, and don't rely on sales conversations alone.

faq.question: How good is Wati's customer support, really?
faq.answer: This is the single most common complaint across independent review platforms (Trustpilot, G2, and Capterra alike). Response times on non-priority tickets are reported to run 1-3 business days, and multiple users describe getting stuck in automated support loops before reaching a human. If responsive support is a priority, factor this into your decision and test it directly during a trial before committing to an annual plan.

faq.question: How does Wati's AI actually get trained on my content?
faq.answer: KnowBot lets you upload files or point it at website URLs, and it automatically answers customer questions based on that ingested content — a real, documented, automatic training method rather than manual scripting. The separate, more advanced Astra AI Agents tier is positioned as a further add-on beyond KnowBot's base capability.

faq.question: What channels does Wati support beyond WhatsApp?
faq.answer: Instagram, RCS (Rich Communication Services), voice, and web chat are all documented — a genuinely broader and more distinctive channel list than several WhatsApp-first competitors, particularly the RCS and voice support, which few competitors in this category offer natively.

pricingBreakdown: Wati's published tier prices ($60-$300/month) look competitive at face value against comparable WhatsApp-focused platforms, but the real cost story is more concerning than a typical 'watch the add-ons' caveat. Per-message WhatsApp fees vary by country code and template type and stack on top of every plan, per-user overages run $24-69/month beyond each tier's included seats, and Shopify integration itself carries an additional $4.99/month charge. Independent analysis has documented cases where the real total bill lands at roughly five times the advertised headline price once all of this is included — a genuinely large gap, not a minor rounding difference. Combined with multiple specific reviewer accounts of being forced into annual billing despite being told the plan was monthly, and reports of continued charges after a cancellation request, the honest advice here is to get every cost component and cancellation term confirmed in writing before signing anything, and to model your real expected message volume and per-user cost rather than budgeting from the headline tier price alone.

verdict: Wati's technical foundation is more credible than most WhatsApp-focused competitors — it grew out of an enterprise chatbot maker with JPMorgan and Fidelity as clients, and Shopify's own strategic investment in the Series B lines up with a genuinely deep, purpose-built commerce integration: a dedicated app that recovers abandoned carts and answers order questions directly inside WhatsApp. The broader AI stack, KnowBot training on your own files and URLs plus a context-aware AI Support Agent and the more advanced Astra AI Agents tier, is real, tiered sophistication rather than a single generic chatbot bolted onto a messaging tool. Channel breadth is also genuinely wider than typical for this category, with RCS and voice support alongside the expected WhatsApp, Instagram, and web chat. All of that said, I have to be direct about what independent reviewers keep describing, because it's serious and specific rather than vague: multiple accounts of being forced into annual billing despite being told the plan was monthly, reports of continued charges after cancellation requests, and independently documented cases where the real total bill lands at roughly five times the advertised headline price once message fees and add-ons stack up. Layer on customer support being the single most repeated complaint across every major review platform, with multi-day response times and automated loops before reaching a human, and the honest picture is a genuinely capable product wrapped in a customer relationship that multiple independent, specific accounts describe as adversarial around billing. My honest read: if Wati's Shopify-specific AI commerce capability is genuinely what you need, it's real and worth evaluating — but go in with every cost component and cancellation term confirmed in writing, monitor your first few billing cycles closely, and don't assume a sales conversation's verbal terms will hold without documentation.
